items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: We were talking about how we used to run around together playing with the trio, playing mandolin guitar and bass.

ctx.x: Second reel Mr. Garland. So we were talking about a string trio you say?

Yeah. With Eddie? We were talking about Eddie Darcy, yeah. Yeah. We were talking about how we used to run around together playing with the trio, playing mandolin guitar and bass. Nah, he's playing bass violin himself. Playing good bass too.
Well Bro told me he used to play that mandolin around town. What was Bro? Bro, Bro told me he did.
